content.text: The seller's counter of 1220 pence per piece checks as "strong," meaning it's comfortably inside the buyer's limit. With only two cards left and no checked price below it this round, I'll accept rather than risk an unchecked counter.
The seller's 2500 is outside the buyer's limit, so I can't accept it. I've already used this round's price check, so I'm offering a step up from our 1600 opener that is well below 2500.
